package handler

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	syncsender "example.com/moba-practice/game/handler/syncsender"
	"example.com/moba-practice/game/moba"
	"example.com/moba-practice/loadtest"
	"example.com/moba-practice/protocol/msgid"
	"example.com/moba-practice/protocol/pb"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/client/wire"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/lockstep"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/nettransport"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
)

// 真实 loopback KCP：固定测试凭据建立会话，输入经可靠通道，广播经 datagram，追帧经可靠通道。
// 这是网络 / 模拟验收，不把固定绑定说成真实账号认证，也不据此声明跨机延迟或容量。
func TestMOBAKCPRobotMatchSettlementAndClientResult(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	f := newMOBAFixture(t)
	key := bytes.Repeat([]byte{7}, 32)
	crypt, err := nettransport.NewKCPAESGCM(key)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	listener, err := nettransport.ListenKCP("127.0.0.1:0", crypt, 10, 3)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer listener.Close()
	server, err := nettransport.NewKCPTransport(nettransport.KCPTransportConfig{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer server.Close()
	clients := make([]*nettransport.KCPTransport, 2)
	inboxes := []chan []byte{make(chan []byte, 128), make(chan []byte, 128)}
	for i := range 2 {
		id := nettransport.SessionID(101 + i)
		cipher, err := nettransport.NewKCPAESGCM(key)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		connection, err := nettransport.DialKCP(listener.Addr().String(), cipher, 10, 3)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		_ = connection.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
		if _, err := connection.Write([]byte("moba-test")); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		_ = connection.SetWriteDeadline(time.Time{})
		accepted, err := listener.AcceptKCP()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		_ = accepted.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
		if _, err := accepted.Read(make([]byte, 32)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		_ = accepted.SetReadDeadline(time.Time{})
		if err := server.BindSession(id, accepted); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := server.RegisterSession(nettransport.SessionInfo{ID: id}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		client, err := nettransport.NewKCPTransport(nettransport.KCPTransportConfig{})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		clients[i] = client
		defer client.Close()
		if err := client.BindSession(id, connection); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := client.RegisterSession(nettransport.SessionInfo{ID: id}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := client.BindDatagramHandler(id, func(_ nettransport.SessionID, raw []byte) {
			select {
			case inboxes[i] <- raw:
			case <-ctx.Done():
			}
		}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		go func() {
			for {
				page, err := client.ReceiveReliable(ctx, id)
				if err != nil {
					return
				}
				select {
				case inboxes[i] <- page:
				case <-ctx.Done():
					return
				}
			}
		}()
	}
	m, err := lockstep.NewMatch(lockstep.MatchConfig{Sequencer: lockstep.SequencerConfig{Players: []lockstep.PlayerID{1, 2}, SubmitWindow: 8, MaxInputBytes: 3}, Datagrams: server, Reliable: server, CatchupBatchFrames: 16, CatchupSendWait: 100 * time.Millisecond})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer m.Close()
	for i := range 2 {
		if err := m.Attach(lockstep.PlayerID(i+1), nettransport.SessionID(101+i)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	send := func(i int, c lockstep.Command) {
		t.Helper()
		id := nettransport.SessionID(101 + i)
		raw, err := lockstep.EncodeCommand(c)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := clients[i].SendReliable(ctx, id, raw); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		received, err := server.ReceiveReliable(ctx, id)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		command, err := lockstep.DecodeCommand(received)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if command.Operation == lockstep.OpInput {
			err = moba.Submit(m, uint64(id), command.Frame, command.Payload)
		} else {
			err = m.HandleCommand(id, command)
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	reference := moba.NewState()
	states := make([]*moba.State, 2)
	bots := make([]*robot.LockstepBot, 2)
	catchups := 0
	for i := range 2 {
		bots[i], states[i], err = loadtest.NewBattleBot(lockstep.PlayerID(i+1), loadtest.BattleSink{Send: func(c lockstep.Command) error {
			if c.Operation == lockstep.OpCatchup {
				catchups++
			}
			send(i, c)
			return nil
		}})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	for id := lockstep.FrameID(1); id <= moba.MaxFrames && !reference.Ended; id++ {
		for i := range 2 {
			send(i, lockstep.Command{Operation: lockstep.OpInput, Frame: id, Payload: loadtest.SiegeInput(states[i], i)})
		}
		frame, err := m.Tick(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := reference.Apply(frame); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for i := range 2 {
			for {
				var packet []byte
				select {
				case packet = <-inboxes[i]:
				case <-ctx.Done():
					t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
				}
				frames, err := lockstep.DecodeBroadcast(packet)
				if err != nil || len(frames) == 0 {
					t.Fatalf("network broadcast: %v", err)
				}
				latest := frames[len(frames)-1].ID
				// 刻意在真实网络接收后丢弃超过冗余深度的连续广播，必须靠可靠追帧恢复。
				if !(i == 0 && latest >= 3 && latest <= 8) {
					if err := bots[i].HandleBroadcast(packet); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
				}
				if latest >= id {
					break
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if catchups != 1 || states[0].Digest() != reference.Digest() || states[1].Digest() != reference.Digest() {
		t.Fatalf("KCP / catch-up diverged, requests=%d ticks=%d/%d/%d", catchups, states[0].Tick, states[1].Tick, reference.Tick)
	}
	// 终态只能由服务器参考模拟确认，经正式 Nest 结算；客户端不提交 winner/digest。
	winner, digest, err := reference.Result()
	if err != nil || winner != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("no authoritative win: winner=%d err=%v", winner, err)
	}
	settlement := syncsender.NewMobaSettlementSender(f.engine)
	for range 2 {
		if err := settlement.MultiSync_MOBASettle(ctx, f.result.ID(), f.players[0].ID(), f.players[1].ID(), "robot-kcp-match", digest, false); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	for i := range 2 {
		profile, err := settlement.Sync_MOBAProfile(ctx, f.players[i].ID())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		payload, err := pb.MarshalBattleResult(&pb.BattleResult{Winner: winner, Digest: digest, Gold: profile.Gold, Wins: profile.Wins, Losses: profile.Losses})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		packet, err := wire.Encode([]*wire.Packet{{Flags: wire.FlagPush, MsgID: msgid.MsgResult, Payload: payload}}, 0)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = server.SendReliable(ctx, nettransport.SessionID(101+i), packet); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for {
			var received []byte
			select {
			case received = <-inboxes[i]:
			case <-ctx.Done():
				t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
			}
			// 同一可靠通道的结算走 RS/PB，其他残留帧仍交给 Lockstep Robot。
			if len(received) < 2 || received[0] != 'R' || received[1] != 'S' {
				if err = bots[i].HandleBroadcast(received); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				continue
			}
			packets, err := wire.Decode(received, 0)
			if err != nil || len(packets) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("result framing: %v", err)
			}
			if packets[0].MsgID != msgid.MsgResult || packets[0].Flags != wire.FlagPush {
				t.Fatal("unexpected result envelope")
			}
			result, err := pb.UnmarshalBattleResult(packets[0].Payload)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if result.Winner != 1 || result.Digest != states[i].Digest() {
				t.Fatal("client result disagrees with simulation")
			}
			if i == 0 && (result.Gold != 10 || result.Wins != 1 || result.Losses != 0) || i == 1 && (result.Gold != 0 || result.Wins != 0 || result.Losses != 1) {
				t.Fatalf("duplicate or wrong settlement: %+v", result)
			}
			break
		}
	}

}
